value.summary: The change updates a test fixture to match a struct definition change: the `next_state` field (built via `EpisodeState::opened`) is replaced with the `watermark` and `round_start` fields it was previously constructed from. Using `Sequence(u64::MAX)` for `round_start` is consistent with the visibility check `message.sequence <= turn.round_start` seen in the vendored crate, so nothing is withheld — matching the old sequential behavior. Other test files in the same crate use the same pattern. No defects found.
